trigger_condition: User supplies non-existent custom root path for any parameter
guard_snippet: foreach ($p in @($BackendRoot,$FrontendRoot,$PackagingRoot)) { if (-not (Test-Path $p -PathType Container)) { throw "Required directory not found: $p" } }; then Resolve-Path
potential_consequence: Resolve-Path throws cryptic termination error; friendly validation message never reached

trigger_condition: nginx.conf checked out on Windows with git autocrlf=true (CRLF line endings)
potential_consequence: CRLF in nginx.conf may cause nginx config parse errors inside Linux container

trigger_condition: Repo path is not a git repository or HEAD is detached on rev-parse
potential_consequence: Git error text logged verbatim as branch/SHA; misleading source-state record persists in build log

trigger_condition: Container engine build exits non-zero after ctx/ assembly
potential_consequence: Potentially large ctx/ tree left on disk after every failed build; accumulates on repeated retries

trigger_condition: Engine binary on PATH but container daemon not running (e.g. podman machine stopped)
guard_snippet: & $Engine info 2>&1 | Out-Null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw "Engine '$Engine' daemon not reachable." }
potential_consequence: Script assembles full context then fails at step 10 with an opaque daemon-connection error

trigger_condition: Two concurrent script invocations share the same PSScriptRoot
guard_snippet: use a per-invocation ctx dir, e.g. ctx-<PID> or ctx-<timestamp>, or place a lock file before Remove-Item
potential_consequence: Second run deletes first run's ctx/ mid-build; non-deterministic build failure for parallel invocations
